sections.heading: Interpretation
Amount in Hong Kong dollars includes its equivalent in any foreign currency
sections.text: In these Rules, a reference to an amount expressed in Hong Kong dollars includes its equivalent in any foreign currency.

sections.heading: Persons prescribed as professional investors
Trust corporations
sections.text: A trust corporation specified for the purposes of section 3(a) is a trust corporation having been entrusted under one or more trusts of which it acts as a trustee with total assets of not less than $40 million at the relevant date or as ascertained in accordance with section 8.

sections.heading: Individuals
Corporations
Partnerships
sections.text:
A partnership specified for the purposes of section 3(d) is a partnership having—
  (a) a portfolio of not less than $8 million; or
  (b) total assets of not less than $40 million,
at the relevant date or as ascertained in accordance with section 8.
